# School_Management_System

> A learning-focused school administration and fee management platform built with ASP.NET Core, Blazor Interactive Server, EF Core, and MySQL.

## Project documents

- [README](README.md): current repository status, planned stack, and module overview
- [Implementation plan](plan.md): architecture, roles, data model, workflows, calculations, and seven-phase roadmap
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): implementation workflow, coding guidance, and data-protection rules
- [Full AI context](llms-full.txt): expanded project summary
- [MIT License](LICENSE): repository license

## Current status

Phases 1–6 are implemented in source. The Phase 6 migration is generated but has not been applied because the local MySQL service is unavailable in this environment. Phase 6 adds validated student and teacher marks workbook imports, Excel student and finance exports, invoice/receipt/report-card PDFs, staff-authorized document ZIPs, audience-based announcements, parent-teacher messages with private attachments, append-only application audit events, SMTP-backed identity/reminder email, and a hosted outbox worker. The solution builds; Phase 2–6 browser walkthroughs remain pending. SSLCOMMERZ needs sandbox credentials and a public HTTPS callback host; SMTP needs local credentials.
